title: Directed Hom continuity in the exact two-open comparison diagrams
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRingCat a diagram with colimit cocone c, i∈I, Z a scheme and t:Z→Spec(R_i) locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume the shared scheme and localized-open derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix j≥i; the hypothesis hstage says every pair of opens of Y_j admits k≥j (the index j itself suffices). Put Y_j=Z×Spec(R_j), X=Z×Spec(c.pt), and g_j:X→Y_j the canonical map. Let U,V be compact opens covering Y_j, A,B perfect objects on their open subschemes [def-pc-perfect-complex], E∈D(X), and φU,φV the given isomorphisms of their limit pullbacks with the exact restrictions of E [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. For EVERY k≥j there are exact coherent two-open comparison diagrams d_k [def-pc-two-open-comparison-diagram], functorial transports κU,κV and siteU,siteV, and θU,θV equal to the composites of these transports with the supplied φU,φV. Their overlap composites ψ_k(false)=γU.symm(A′)≫SP(θU)≫τU(E) and ψ_k(true)=γV.symm(B′)≫SQ(θV)≫τV(E) identify HW_k(SU_k(A′)) and HW_k(SV_k(B′)) with RW(E). For the categories C_k=D((f_kj^{-1}U∩f_kj^{-1}V).toScheme), the two objects F_k(false)=SU_k(A′), F_k(true)=SV_k(B′), the actual functors G_k=HW_k and target objects O(false)=O(true)=RW(E), there is a DirectedPerfectHomSystem: transports preserve identity, composition and the conjugated limit image; all four kinds of limit Hom morphisms lift; and equal limit images eventually imply equality at EVERY later stage. No overlap isomorphism or inverse equations are asserted.

source.place: Tag 09RE, lemma-descend-homomorphisms; Tag 09RF, fully faithful overlap descent before gluing

proof.text: The compact overlap of U,V is compact by quasi-separatedness; its open immersion and structural map are finitely presented. Restrict A,B to this overlap and use preservation of perfectness. Base-change and open restriction identify their stage and limit pullbacks.

At each index of the directed tail construct the simultaneous diagram from pullback on open subschemes followed by inverse open-site equivalences. Canonical composition and restriction comparisons provide κ and site maps. Define θ by the displayed composites with φ. Their overlap composites are ψ, and naturality and composition coherence identify the conjugated map with the canonical perfect Hom limit map.

Apply perfect_hom_continuity on the directed tail to each of the four ordered pairs of perfect overlap restrictions. Surjectivity supplies lift and its eventual-equality clause supplies equal at every later stage. The canonical pullback transports preserve identity and composition and commute with limit maps. Package these maps and laws in DirectedPerfectHomSystem; no inverse is descended.

theorem perfect_overlap_hom_continuity
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hstage : ∀ (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens),
      ∃ k : I, j ≤ k)
    : perfectOverlapHomContinuityStatement R c hc i Z t j hij hstage
